## SECTION 1: The 40 Proven Listing Titles

### Formula Key
Etsy titles have a 140-character limit. The first 40 characters matter most for search ranking. Always lead with your strongest keyword.

**The Winning Structure:**
`[Primary Keyword] | [Secondary Keyword] — [Benefit/Occasion/Recipient]`

## SECTION 2: Tag Formulas That Actually Work

Etsy allows 13 tags per listing. Use all 13. Never repeat words already in your title. Tags should cover **lateral searches** — different ways buyers describe the same item.

### The 13-Tag Blueprint

| Tag Slot | Strategy | Example |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Core product + phone model | `iphone 15 phone case` |
| 2 | Design descriptor | `wildflower floral case` |
| 3 | Aesthetic/style | `cottagecore aesthetic` |
| 4 | Recipient | `gift for her` |
| 5 | Occasion | `birthday gift` |
| 6 | Emotion/vibe | `cute phone cover` |
| 7 | Alternate device | `samsung galaxy case` |
| 8 | Broader category | `nature phone case` |
| 9 | Niche community | `plant lover gift` |
| 10 | Colour descriptor | `pink floral case` |
| 11 | Use case | `protective phone cover` |
| 12 | Price-point search | `gifts under 20` |
| 13 | Long-tail variation | `unique phone case gift` |

### 🔥 High-Converting Tag Clusters by Niche

**Cottagecore/Nature:**
`cottagecore gift`, `fairy core aesthetic`, `mushroom lover gift`, `forest witch aesthetic`, `nature phone case`, `botanical art print`

**Aesthetic/Trendy:**
`dark academia gift`, `coquette aesthetic`, `y2k accessories`, `indie aesthetic case`, `pinterest aesthetic`, `vsco girl gift`

**Gift Seeker Tags (HIGH buyer intent):**
`gifts for best friend`, `teen girl gift ideas`, `unique birthday gift`, `gifts under 15`, `stocking filler gift`, `secret santa gift`

## SECTION 3: Description Templates

### Template A — The Emotional Hook Description
*Best for: gift-focused listings, aesthetic designs*

```
[OPENING HOOK — 1 sentence that mirrors the buyer's desire]

Because your phone deserves to be as [adjective] as you are.

This [design name] phone case is designed for [ideal customer] who 
love [aesthetic/interest]. Whether you're gifting it to your 
[recipient] or treating yourself — this is the case that gets 
noticed.

✦ PERFECT FOR:
→ [Customer type 1] e.g. Cottagecore lovers and nature girls
→ [Customer type 2] e.g. Anyone who's obsessed with mushrooms
→ [Occasion] e.g. Birthdays, Christmas, just because

✦ PRODUCT DETAILS:
→ High-quality slim/tough case (choose at checkout)
→ Compatible with [list models]
→ Scratch-resistant matte/gloss finish
→ Precise cutouts for camera, buttons & ports
→ Printed & dispatched within 2-3 business days

✦ ORDERING:
Select your phone model from the dropdown menu above. 
Don't see your model listed? Send us a message — we add 
new models regularly.

📦 UK orders: 3-5 days | International: 7-14 days

This listing is for a phone case only. All designs are 
original artwork, printed on-demand just for you.

[SHOP NAME] — Aesthetic phone cases for people with good taste.
```

## SECTION 4: Quick-Reference Headline Formulas

Use these to write new titles fast:

- `[Aesthetic] Phone Case + [Device] | [Design Word] — [Gift Occasion]`
- `[Animal] Phone Case | Cute [Device] Cover — [Recipient] Gift`
- `[Quote Theme] Phone Case [Device] | [Style Word] — [Emotion/Vibe]`
- `[Colour] [Pattern] Phone Case | [Device] — [Customer Identity]`
- `[Niche/Job] Gift Phone Case | [Device] — [Occasion] Present`

## Final Checklist Before You Publish

- [ ] Title starts with primary keyword within first 40 characters
- [ ] All 13 tags used — no repeated words from title
- [ ] Description opens with a buyer-desire statement, not product specs
- [ ] Phone models clearly listed in description
- [ ] At least one gift-angle mentioned
- [ ] Dispatch and delivery times included
- [ ] A question/message invitation included
- [ ] Thumbnail shows the design clearly on a real-looking mockup
